resources.name: Standard oxide densities and molecular weights (B2O3, V2O5, BaO, La2O3, Bi2O3)

access.notes: Densities: B2O3 2.46, V2O5 3.36, BaO 5.72, La2O3 6.51, Bi2O3 8.90 g/cm³; molecular weights from periodic table. Available in standard handbooks (CRC) or online databases.

resources.name: Makishima-Mackenzie model parameters: dissociation energies and ionic radii for constituent oxides

access.notes: Dissociation energies (Gi) and packing density factors (Vi) from Makishima & Mackenzie (1973) and Inaba et al. (1999). Tabulated values for B2O3, V2O5, BaO, La2O3, Bi2O3 are available in the literature.

resources.name: Phy-X/PSD online radiation shielding database

access.notes: Free online tool to compute mass attenuation coefficients. Alternatively, the XCOM database or Python package 'pyear' can be used.
